name: 8colors-process-engine
description: Portable Claude Code process engine — 21 agents + 2 session skills + 10 commands + cross-platform schedulers + multi-provider RAG + Claude Code hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop) + 18 git-side hooks + 3 CI templates + unified pe CLI + shared _gate-contract spec + generic database-reviewer + pe docs check + pe collect (git-derived dev-log) + pe telemetry (Claude Code transcript → OTel spans + cost attribution) + pe memory (L3 auto-memory governance: ls/show/rm/verify/stale with per-type staleness defaults) + pe new (A6 project scaffolder — python-flask + generic stacks with deterministic template drop + git init + auto pe install) + pe module add (A6 reusable domain modules — auth: session + bcrypt-12 + Role enum decorators + step-up reauth + IP rate limit; tenancy: Organization + Membership + OrgRole enum + session-based current-org context + require_membership/require_org_role decorators + scoped_query helper + apply_rls_to_table PostgreSQL FORCE-mode RLS migration helper + org switcher/create/members blueprint; api-credentials: encrypted Fernet storage + write-only admin UI + audit log; billing: server-side amount authority + Stripe PaymentIntent adapter + Decimal-only money helpers + HMAC webhook verify + idempotency-by-event_id + FORCE-mode RLS on charges/refunds/payment_events) + S3 security pytest templates (session fixation + HTTPOnly/SameSite/Secure cookies + password-rotation invalidates other sessions; JWT alg=none + RS→HS confusion + expired/missing-exp/wrong-iss; OAuth state param + PKCE-required + exact-match redirect_uri + auth-code single-use; webhook HMAC verify + tampered-payload + stale-timestamp + duplicate-event dedup; payment server-side amount authority + Decimal-not-float + test/live key separation + idempotency-key; reset-token single-use + expiration + high-entropy + no user enumeration) + Security-tests-skip-reason trailer path-gate (money-mutating commits require co-staged test evidence) + S4 LLM/agent threat hardening (transcript-guard PostToolUse hook that scans Bash/Read/WebFetch/WebSearch outputs for 9-class prompt-injection markers + 11-class secret patterns with last-4 previews only; pe verify supply-chain checksum against MANIFEST.sha256 of all agents/hooks/commands/scripts, with --update/--json/--engine modes and adopter-side engine dir auto-resolve) + S5 CI security gates in engine-quality.yml.template (hadolint + trivy fs container-security on Dockerfile presence, feature-detected; weekly gitleaks --source . full-history secrets audit + schedule cron; license-audit with pip-licenses / license-checker fail-on AGPL/GPL-3.0 warn-on LGPL, feature-detected per stack — all continue-on-error advisory) + A7 cross-session agent memory (pe recall <query> scans .pe/decisions.jsonl + reconciliations.jsonl with Jaccard token overlap, collapses per-slot trajectories, --json/--limit/--min-score modes; FTS5 sparse hybrid retrieval added to research_index.py — reciprocal-rank fusion of dense embeddings + BM25 catches exact-token queries like slot IDs, SHAs, snake_case that dense-only misses; retrospective-agent §7b synthesizes ≥3-slot recurring failure_class patterns into feedback auto-memory via pe memory add, capped at 3 new memories per retro) + A8 native plugin manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json + per-project version pin at .claude/.engine-pin.json (pe pin show|verify|bump with drift verdicts pinned/engine_ahead/engine_behind/sha_orphan/ok_no_git; install.sh writes the pin file on every install so adopters no longer silently ride HEAD after pe upgrade) + PF1 perf-gate commit-msg trailer hook (blocks commits touching ORM / query / migration / serializer / repository / schema paths unless the message carries Perf-tested: <sha>, Perf-tested: query-count self-attest, or Perf-skip-reason: <text>; sha resolves against .claude/gates/perf.json for PASS/WARN verdicts; ENGINE_PERF_PATHS overrides the path regex; tests/ paths are exempt as evidence) + PF4 soak template (templates/tests/soak.test.py.template — TestSoak class with rss-linear-slope + gc-reclaim cases, dual thresholds MAX_RSS_GROWTH_MB + MAX_SLOPE_MB_PER_100REQ, tracemalloc top-N frames printed on failure, psutil RSS with /proc fallback, gc.collect before sampling for steady-state) + PF5 k6 load template (templates/perf/load-test.k6.js.template — ramping-vus scenario warmup→50VU→ramp-down, thresholds split by list/detail/write endpoint class p95 + error rate, env-driven BASE_URL/AUTH_TOKEN, 70/20/10 traffic mix with think-time) + engine-quality.yml.template load-test-k6 job (workflow_dispatch-only with run_load_test + load_test_base_url inputs, k6 install + k6-summary.json artifact upload, continue-on-error advisory) + claude-md-size dual-mode guard + complexity/duplication/size-budget gates + Ponytail as universal prerequisite (default-on install, PreToolUse advisory hook on Write/Edit/MultiEdit, decision-ladder preambles across 7 code-writing agents) + /simplify chain stage + boot-smoke + migration-lint + design-lint (multi-theme) + copy-lint + Playwright smoke template + confusion-budget test + auth-robustness pytest template + design-critic agent with evidence-verified envelope + axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA gate + Lighthouse CI perf/a11y budgets + backend p95 latency template + gate-efficacy eval corpus with 5 seeded gates (security-reviewer, code-reviewer, database-reviewer, tdd-guide, design-critic) + shape-mode + live-mode runners + pe agent run (A4 execution primitive — headless `claude -p` wrapper) + pe incident propose (A3 incident → gate synthesizer; proposes never applies). Enforcement is deterministic, not prompt-hope.
